'''Masako Nozawa''' (Japanese: '''野沢雅子''' ''Nozawa Masako'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nozawa was born on October 25, 1936, in former {{wp|Tokyo City}}, {{wp|Tokyo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She became a voice actress as an adult and led a long and prolific voice acting career since the late 1930s. For {{aniseries|PTS}}, Nozawa notably provided her voice for [[Morrison]], one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s in the [[Ever Grande Conference]], during {{aniseries|RS}}. She then returned to voice [[Harriet]] for [[M21|the twenty-first movie]]. At various points during her career, she was affiliated with the talent agencies {{wp|Production Baobab}}, {{wp|81 Produce}}, and the self-owned Office Nozawa. Nozawa was married to the late voice actor {{wp|Masaaki Tsukada}} and is currently affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
